title: Sephirot sortie flow, MAGI and timeline
goal: The sortie flow diagram (stages, MAGI vote, timeline) renders in the workspace from real stages and timings
acceptance: Stage nodes, edges, MAGI result and timeline match live.js for the same sortie; no simulated stages in live mode

privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
